name: Drata
description: Drata is a security and compliance automation platform for frameworks, controls, tests, evidence, personnel, devices, vendors, risk, audits, documents, and continuous monitoring.
agentUseSummary: Add a customer-owned expiring API key with only Frameworks: List Frameworks permission, then bind one exact workspace and documented region. Selected agents can list only bounded, minimized framework metadata. Relay blocks requirements, controls, evidence, people, broad APIs, and every mutation.

providerSetup.blocker: No customer has supplied an unexpired Drata API key with only Frameworks: List Frameworks permission, one exact workspace ID, and its us, eu, or apac region, and non-production lifecycle acceptance has not been completed.
providerSetup.nextAction: A Drata administrator creates an expiring, IP-restricted key with only Frameworks: List Frameworks permission, records the exact workspace ID and region, stores all values through Relay's encrypted credential flow, then validates bounded reads, permission denial, expiration, rotation/revocation, disconnect, rate limiting, terms acceptance, and post-disconnect denial in non-production.

evidence.supports: Drata documents V2's /public/v2 path, bearer API-key authentication, cursor pagination, minimized responses, and fixed North America, Europe, and Asia-Pacific API origins.

Drata documents workspace-bound framework listing, the exact Frameworks: List Frameworks permission, 1-500 page size, cursor pagination, response fields, terms acceptance, and mutating framework operations that Relay excludes.
Drata documents customer API-key creation, custom least-privilege scopes, expiration and IP restrictions, one-time key display, revocation, and a 500 requests per minute per-IP limit.

Drata's official API catalog shows the broad assets, controls, evidence, personnel, devices, vendors, risks, audits, documents, workspaces, custom data, and mutating surface that remains outside this connector.
